children: Brazil's central bank announced on Friday measures to strengthen the responsibilities of financial institutions in offering and granting credit, with the new rules set to be valid during the next year.

Among the measures, the central bank will require financial institutions to provide clients with mechanisms to block proactive credit offers, it said in a statement. There are also new rules governing credit offers during the initiation of transactions with instant payment method Pix, it added.
